## Trump Approval Rating at 40% Among Likely Voters

40% of likely voters approve of the job President Trump is doing in office, and 59% disapprove. Likely voters are more than twice as likely to strongly disapprove (53%) of President Trump’s job performance than to strongly approve (24%). The president’s approval rating notches down to 38% among registered voters nationally. Among this group, 61% disapprove.

# Trump approval hits record second-term low: Survey

#### White House Headlines - November 13, 2026

President Trump’s job approval rating sits at a second-term low in a new postelection survey, showing little sign of improvement after his party suffered widespread losses in the midterms.

In the new Economist/YouGov poll, 63 percent of Americans said they disapproved of Trump’s job performance, including 52 percent who disapproved strongly, with just 32 percent approving.

# Trump approval rating sinks to new record low in new poll

President Donald Trump’s approval rating has fallen to a new low in Economist/YouGov polling since he returned to the White House, with fewer than one-third of Americans approving of his job performance.

The poll, released Thursday, Nov. 12, found 32% approve of the job Trump is doing as president, down four percentage points from the previous week and below his previous second-term low of 33%, recorded in August.
